propositions: Container tickets with children currently declare empty file_impact, causing plan-review attestations to fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation where any unrelated commit invalidates the container's review.

Container plan-review scope should inherit the union of direct children's declared file_impact, applying a poison rule: if any non-closed child has empty file_impact, inheritance is disabled and the set falls back to empty (whole-HEAD invalidation).
Closed children must not contribute files to the inherited union and must not trigger the poison rule, as their work is already delivered and covered by ADR 0024's completion floor.

When inheritance is effective (all non-closed direct children declare non-empty file_impact), unrelated commits must not invalidate the container attestation, but commits to child-declared files must block the claim and name drift.
Child file_impact edits after container review must invalidate the container's attestation via pin/material drift, forcing re-review to recompute inherited scope.
P9 validation must surface an advisory (never blocking) on containers with poisoned inheritance, naming the children with empty file_impact, while keeping existing leaf behavior unchanged.
